questions.question: X, Y and Z can complete a piece of work in 20,12 and 28 days, respectively. If all work together, the approximate number of days to complete the work will be:
questions.solution:
**Given : **

X, Y and Z can complete a piece of work in 20,12 and 28 days.

**Formula Used : **

Work done = time × efficiency

**Calculation : **

Total work = LCM(20,12, 28) = 420

Efficiency of X = 420/20 = 21

Efficiency of Y = 420/12 = 35

Efficiency of Z = 420/28 = 15

Time taken by (X + Y + Z) together = 420/(21 + 35 + 15) = 5.91 (approx)

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

questions.question: Deepak starts a business with a capital of ₹1,60,000. He incurs a loss of 10% during the first year. But he makes a profit of 5% during the second year on his remaining investment. Finally, he makes a profit of 25% on his new capital during the third year. Find his total profit at the end of three years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive multiplying factor = (90/100) × (105/100) × (125/100)

Final Amount = ₹1,60,000 × (9/10) × (21/20) × (5/4)

Final Amount = ₹1,60,000 × (945/800)

Final Amount = ₹200 × 945 = ₹1,89,000

Total Profit = Final Amount − Initial Capital = ₹1,89,000 − ₹1,60,000 = ₹29,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹29,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Capital (P) = ₹1,60,000

Loss in 1st year = 10%

Profit in 2nd year = 5%

Profit in 3rd year = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Final Amount = P × (1 − L/100) × (1 + P₁/100) × (1 + P₂/100)

Total Profit = Final Amount − Initial Capital

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e18c55a6644b8c5d8fdf81ee0fb739651ea779f64db47e78ddf0194156ef5b3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount after 1st year = 1,60,000 × (1 − 10/100)

⇒ Amount after 1st year = 1,60,000 × (90/100) = ₹1,44,000

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 1,44,000 × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 1,44,000 × (105/100) = ₹1,51,200

⇒ Amount after 3rd year = 1,51,200 × (1 + 25/100)

⇒ Amount after 3rd year = 1,51,200 × (125/100) = ₹1,89,000

⇒ Total Profit = Final Amount − Initial Capital

⇒ Total Profit = 1,89,000 − 1,60,000 = ₹29,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹29,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value experiences continuous sequential changes, the net resultant value is determined by continuously multiplying the base amount with successive fractional factors: Final = Base × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100).

Equivalent Percentage Change

For two consecutive percentage changes of a% and b%, the combined overall percentage effect can be strictly derived from the direct formula: Net Change = (a + b + ab/100)%. In this formula, instances of decline or loss must be appropriately noted as negative quantities.

Compound Interest Analogy

The arithmetic principle of determining consecutive profits or losses computed on a continually updated principal is structurally identical to the framework of Compound Interest, wherein accrued amounts inherently form the foundation for the next interest period.

questions.question: If θ is an acute angle and sin θ cos θ = 2 cos³ θ-(1)/(4) cos θ, then the value of sin θ is:

questions.question: In a mixture, the ratio of a chemical X and water is 15 ∶ 9. When 48 litres of this mixture is replaced with water, the ratio becomes 11 ∶ 13. Find the quantity of water after replacement.
questions.solution:
**Given : **

Ratio of a chemical X and water is 15 ∶ 9.

48 litres of this mixture is replaced with water, the ratio becomes 11 ∶ 13.

**Calculation : **

48 liters of water is taken out in which chemical X is 30 and water is 18.

⇒ 15x - 30/(9x - 18 + 48) = 11/13

⇒ 15x - 30/(9x + 30) = 11/13

⇒ 195x - 390 = 99x + 330

⇒ 96x = 720

⇒ x = 720/96 = 7.5

Quantity of water after replacement = 9 × 7.5 + 30 = 97.5

**∴ The correct answer is 97.5.**

questions.question: Three partners P, Q and R invest ₹1,000, ₹1,200 and ₹1,500, respectively, in a business. What should be the share of Q if the total profit is ₹666?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of investments = 1000 : 1200 : 1500 = 10 : 12 : 15.

Since the time period is identical, profit is distributed in the ratio of their investments.

Share of Q = [12 ÷ (10 + 12 + 15)] × Total Profit

Share of Q = (12 ÷ 37) × 666 = 12 × 18 = 216.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment of P = ₹1000

Investment of Q = ₹1200

Investment of R = ₹1500

Total profit = ₹666

**Formula Used:**

When the investment time is the same for all partners, Profit Ratio = Capital Ratio.

 Investment and Profit Share Ratio
 
 
 P
 10 parts
 ₹1000

 
 Q
 12 parts
 ₹1200

 
 R
 15 parts
 ₹1500

 
• 
 

 

 Total Profit = ₹666 (37 parts)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio of profits (P : Q : R) = 1000 : 1200 : 1500

⇒ Simplifying the ratio, we get 10 : 12 : 15

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 10 + 12 + 15 = 37 parts

⇒ Value of 37 parts = ₹666

⇒ Value of 1 part = 666 ÷ 37 = ₹18

⇒ Profit share of Q = 12 parts

⇒ Share of Q = 12 × 18 = ₹216

**∴ The correct answer is ₹216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Different Time Periods

If partners invest for different durations, their profit is shared in the ratio of the product of their Capital and Time (C₁ × T₁ : C₂ × T₂).

Working & Sleeping Partners

A working partner receives a fixed salary or a specific percentage of the total profit for managing the business. The remaining profit is distributed among all partners according to their investment ratios.

Compound Partnership

When a partner withdraws or adds money during the year, their capital is broken into time segments. The equivalent capital is calculated as (Amount₁ × Months₁) + (Amount₂ × Months₂).

questions.question: If (a+b+c) = 20 and a2 +b2+c2 = 262, then find the value of ab+bc+ca.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 20

a2 +b2+c2 = 262

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2 ab + 2 bc + 2 ca 

(a + b + c)² = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation:**

As we know,

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ (20)² = 262 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 400 = 262 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒400 - 262 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒138 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒(ab + bc + ca) = 69

**∴ The value of (ab + bc + ca) is 69.**

In triangle STU, V is a point on the side ST and W is a point on the side SU such that VWUT is a trapezium. Given that VW ∶ TU = 2 ∶ 7, what is the ratio of area of trapezium VWUT to the area of the triangle STU?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In a triangle STU, V is a point on side ST and W is a point on side SU such that VWUT is a trapezium

VW : TU = 2 : 7

**Concept used:**

**Thales theorem (Basic Proportionality Theorem)**

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle intersecting the other two sides in distinct points, 

then the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/976c703c594b2517159960c7c87d2fcd13e5ba57d9123ec0d4bee9ccbb76f0c1.png] 

AP/PB = AQ/QC

**Note:**

**If APQ and ABC are similar then,**

Area of APQ/ Area of ABC = (PQ)² : (BC)²

and the side ratio will be,

PQ/BC = AP/AB = AQ/AC

**Calculation:**

According to question,

In the figure, VW : TU = 2 : 7 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dcfb615ea93b48b7e79abe1fd666800d9fde8b4e843d5eb64c950a49f46262b.png] 

As we know, SVW and STU both are similar then

SV/ST = SW/SU = VW/ TU = 2 : 7

So, we can say

SV = 2 unit

ST = 7 unit

⇒ST = SV + VT

⇒ 7 = 2 + VT

⇒ VT = 5 unit

According to Thales theorem,

⇒SV : VT = SW : WU = 2 : 5

Ratio of area of SVW and area of STU will be,

Area of SVW : Area of STU = (VW)² : (TU)²

⇒Area of SVW : Area of STU = 2² : 7²

⇒Area of SVW : Area of STU = 4 : 49

⇒Area of SVW = 4 units

⇒Area of STU = 49 units

So, 

Area of STU = Area of SVW + Area of VWUT

⇒Area of VWUT = Area of STU - Area of SVW

⇒Area of VWUT = 49 - 4

⇒Area of VWUT = 45 unit

So, the ratio of area of trapezium VWUT and area of triangle STU will be,

⇒ Area of VWUT : Area of STU = 45 : 49

**∴ The correct answer is 45:49.**

questions.question: Sanjana can row a boat at 9 km/h in the still water. It takes her twice as long to row up a certain distance as to row down the same distance in the river. What is the rate of the stream (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
**Given : **

v = 9 km/hr

Time Upstream = 2 × Downstream

**Formula Used :**

Speed in Downstream = v + u

Speed in Upstream = v - u

**Calculation : **

⇒ D/(v - u) = 2 × D/(v + u)

⇒ v + u = 2 × (v - u)

⇒ 9 + u = 2(9 - u)

⇒ 3u = 9

⇒ u = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**
